review: Fresh independent current-v9 final source/key/scope/coverage challenge
scope: Unmatched: Battle of Legends, Volume One (2019), English IELLO core and original four hero/action components, with official IELLO/Restoration August11,2025 Excalibur erratum. Standard duel; teams, other sets, Adventures excluded. Q64 explicitly asks the historical original interpretation, retained unchanged; current play follows2025 rule and is directly asked Q66.

findings.historical_rejection_override: R16 and R21 are historical, superseded by allowed addendum and verified current official source. Neither creates a present authority or human-input dependency.

all_67_id_checks.actual_question: How is a duel set up: cards and health, who places where and in what order, legal sidekick spaces including a multizone hero space, when is Alice’s initial size chosen, and who takes the first turn?
actual_required_facts: each player takes their hero’s matching components and sets character-card starting health (undialed sidekicks have 1 health each)
Shuffle each 30-card deck separately and draw 5
Younger places hero on 1 then sidekicks in separate spaces sharing any zone of that hero; choose Alice’s size on placement
Older places hero on 2 then sidekicks by the same rules
Younger takes first turn
contextual_exclusions: Choose a battlefield (true setup background; question enumerates cards/health/placement/order/size/first turn).
Source procedure forms a face-down deck. The existing reference to a defined deck is adequate equivalent wording; no additional face-down physical inventory clause is demanded by this question.
all_67_id_checks.independent_check: PDF p6 fixes younger hero1, then its separate sidekicks sharing any hero zone; older hero2 and own sidekicks second; size selected at placement. Each matching30-card deck is shuffled and draws5; character health, including1 for undialed sidekicks, is set. Younger begins. Scope correctly treats choosing battlefield and a separate face-down apparatus inventory as background.

all_67_id_checks.actual_question: What actions must you take on a turn, may you repeat or skip an action, and when and how do you enforce the 7-card hand limit if you temporarily hold 9?
actual_required_facts: Take 2 actions from maneuver, scheme, attack; may repeat the same action but cannot skip
May hold 9 during turn; at end discard 2 to own discard pile to reach 7
contextual_exclusions: Opponent’s turn follows; not a separate requested clause.
all_67_id_checks.independent_check: PDF p8 requires exactly2 maneuver/scheme/attack actions, permitting repetition and forbidding skips. Temporarily holding9 is allowed; end-turn discard2 to own pile reaches7. Following opponent turn is correct unasked background.

all_67_id_checks.actual_question: During an ordinary maneuver, in what order do drawing and movement occur, which fighters may move how far, and can you pass through friendly or enemy fighters, end on an occupied space, or interleave two fighters’ moves?
actual_required_facts: Draw 1 first, mandatory; movement optional
Each of your fighters may move from zero up to the character move value; choose each fighter’s distance independently.
Move one fighter completely before another in any order
May pass own friendly fighters but never end occupied; cannot pass opposing fighters
contextual_exclusions: Each entered space must be adjacent to previous space. Q03 does not independently ask path definition; drawing/movement order, allowance, transit, occupied endpoint and interleaving remain required.
all_67_id_checks.independent_check: PDF p9: mandatory draw1 precedes optional movement. Each own fighter independently moves0 through character allowance, one complete move at a time in any chosen order. Friendly transit allowed, opposing transit blocked, occupied endpoint forbidden. Adjacent-step definition is true source background rather than another omission clause.

all_67_id_checks.actual_question: How do you BOOST maneuver movement, what happens to the discarded card’s printed effect, who receives the movement increase, and may a defeated sidekick’s unusable card pay for it?
actual_required_facts: Discard 1 hand card and add its BOOST value to movement value for the maneuver, applying to each fighter
Ignore discarded card’s effect
Cards unusable because their fighter is defeated may still be discarded to BOOST
all_67_id_checks.independent_check: PDF p10: discard exactly1 hand card; its BOOST adds to the maneuver movement value used by every fighter. Payment effect is ignored; cards of defeated fighters remain eligible payments if they have a BOOST value.

all_67_id_checks.actual_question: Your empty deck is asked to draw 2 cards by a mandatory effect while your hero and a sidekick survive. Do you reshuffle or decline the draws, and what damage does each fighter take?
actual_required_facts: Do not reshuffle or decline; draws mandatory unless otherwise specified
Each failed draw immediately deals 2 damage to each fighter, thus 4 each over two draws if game continues and they survive; hero defeat ends game immediately

all_67_id_checks.actual_question: For a melee fighter and a ranged fighter, which targets are legal if adjacent across a zone boundary, nonadjacent in the same zone, or in a disconnected part of the same colored zone?

[Unmatched] Inarrêtable Excalibur !
[Unmatched] Inarrêtable Excalibur !
Publié le 11 août 2025
Nos partenaires de Restoration Games viennent d’officialiser
un changement de règles
concernant le personnage du Roi Arthur.
Pour comprendre ce changement, il faut prendre le temps de revenir sur la capacité d’Arthur, qui indique ceci :
« Lorsque le Roi Arthur combat, il peut BOOSTER son attaque. Jouez la carte BOOST, face cachée, avec votre carte Attaque. Si votre adversaire annule les effets de votre carte Attaque, la carte BOOST est défaussée, sans effet. »
Le changement de règle implique la carte Excalibur, une carte d’attaque de valeur 6. Auparavant, si la carte Excalibur, une fois boostée, était contrée par une Feinte, la Feinte avait pour effet de défausser la carte utilisée pour le Boost. Ce n’est plus le cas désormais, dans une modification officielle apportée par Restoration Games.
Cette règle prend donc immédiatement effet, aussi bien pour le jeu amical que pour les tournois :
« Comme Excalibur n’a aucun effet imprimé sur sa carte, ses effets ne peuvent pas être annulés. Si Arthur utilise sa capacité pour BOOSTER Excalibur, la carte utilisée pour le BOOST n’est pas défaussée si l’adversaire annule les effets sur Excalibur. »
